description: Exposed first-use 2026-10-09 Otten blind4 FAILED 7/24. Converted to post-hoc REGRESSION; not an independent blind.

blind_metadata.article: Bending properties of different REBCO coated conductor tapes and Roebel cables at T = 77 K
blind_metadata.authors: Simon Otten, Anna Kario, Andrea Kling, Wilfried Goldacker
blind_metadata.source_file: User Library: Otten et al. - 2016 - Bending properties of different REBCO coated conductor tapes and Roebel cables at T = 77 K.pdf
blind_metadata.source_pages: Physical PDF pages 2-4, 7-8 (1-based); cover page is page 1
blind_metadata.first_use: 24 new exact-source excerpts collected after the v1.7.24 Windows regression PASS. No prior grader scoring on this corpus.
blind_metadata.normalization: PDF line wraps and soft hyphens removed, math symbol infinity rendered as U+221E, bibliographic square-bracket citations retained in selected source sentences
blind_metadata.privacy: No PDF, personal user material, or credentials bundled. English source excerpts are from an already published scientific paper.
blind_metadata.caution: Blind4 is a one-time unseen evaluation; any failures convert it into regression evidence; do not tune the v1.7.24 grader using these cases before first Windows evaluation.

cases.source_text: The minimum bending radius is defined as the lowest radius for which the irreversible degradation is less than 5%.
cases.user_answer: 最小曲げ半径は、不可逆的な劣化が5%未満となる範囲で最も小さい曲げ半径と定義する。
cases.case_rationale: Preserves strict less-than threshold and definition.

cases.source_text: Impregnation prevents the strands from sliding relative to each other and makes the cable inflexible.
cases.user_answer: 含浸は素線同士の相対的なすべりを妨げ、ケーブルの柔軟性を失わせる。
cases.case_rationale: Faithful causal account of strand sliding and cable stiffness.

cases.source_text: The bending strain is negative when the REBCO layer is on the inside of the bend, since it is compressed.
cases.user_answer: REBCO層が曲げの内側にある場合、圧縮されるため、曲げひずみが負になることが起こるということになる。
cases.case_rationale: Clumsy double occurrence/predication for a correct negative-strain relationship.

cases.source_text: Both cables had a transposition length [3] of 226 mm and consisted of 15 strands.
cases.user_answer: 両ケーブルは転位長が226 mmであるということになっており、15本の素線から構成されているということになっている。
cases.case_rationale: Redundant it-is-the-case phrasing, figures and relationship preserved.

cases.source_text: The effect however needs to be taken into account if the magnet is pre-tested at T = 77 K.
cases.user_answer: ただし、磁石をT = 77 Kで事前試験する場合、この影響を考慮することが必要となることが求められる。
cases.case_rationale: Redundant need/require nominalizations with the correct condition.

cases.source_text: All tested conductors are found to tolerate compressive bending to a radius of 6 mm with less than 5% irreversible degradation of the critical current.
cases.user_answer: 試験したすべての導体は、臨界電流にほとんど不可逆的な劣化を生じずに圧縮曲げに耐えた。
cases.case_rationale: Omits both 6 mm radius and below-5% quantitative limits.

cases.source_text: Impregnation should therefore be done after the cable is bent into the coil shape.
cases.user_answer: したがって、含浸はケーブルをコイル形状に曲げる前に実施すべきである。
cases.case_rationale: Reverses procedure order from after to before.
